title: The will for a will: Adam Kadmon as the true creation from nothing
overview:
The chapter goes one step below the *ratzon kadum*. That preceding will, for Himself, is a will for the end of the deed; out of it comes a *ratzon l'ratzon*, a will for a will: the will to have any will needed to get the final thing. Will for *Atzilus*, will for *Beriya* like an architect, will for *Asiya*, and even for the dirt and the noise of the building site. These ten wills for a will are the ten *sefiros* of *Adam Kadmon*, the hidden root of the revealed *sefiros* of *Atzilus*.

*Adam Kadmon* is the Man of *Beriya* because a will for a will is created *yesh me'ayin* and stays a nothing: when the buddy shows up with the pizza, the will to find the keys is gone without a trace, as the world would be if the *Aibershter* took His mind off it. *Adam Kadmon* is the *ma'atzil*; *Atzilus* only reveals it. Above it is the *ratzon kadum* itself, still thinking only of itself, of sitting and not of a chair: the *Rambam*'s "knowledge of Himself". No class reads the chapter's first fourteen lines; after a jump in the tape, only his explanation of lines 13-14 is heard.

sections.title: The Keser of Adam Kadmon is the true creation from nothing
sections.summary: The last level of the *ratzon kadum* becomes the *Keser* of *Adam Kadmon*, which is called a creation *yesh me'ayin*, the true one, because the *ratzon kadum* is the *hiyuli* source of every will for a will. The series has no class on these lines.

phrases.he: (יח) והנה בחינת רצון הקדום לעצמו,
phrases.en: (18) Now, the *ratzon kadum* (the preceding will) for Himself:

phrases.he: כל מה שיהיה בהשתלשלות,
phrases.en: all that will be in the chain of descent,

phrases.he: שכלול מי'
phrases.en: which is made up of ten,

phrases.he: עד בחינת סוף מעשה שעלה ברצון קדום זה,
phrases.en: down to the end of the deed, which arose in this *ratzon kadum*,

phrases.he: שהוא בחינת אחרונה שבו
phrases.en: which is its last level;

phrases.he: הרי מבחינת מלכות שבעליון
phrases.en: for from the *Malchus* of the higher

phrases.he: נעשה כתר לתחתון כו'
phrases.en: comes the *Keser* of the lower.

phrases.he: והוא בחינת כתר דאדם קדמון,
phrases.en: This is the *Keser* of *Adam Kadmon*,

phrases.he: להיות ידוע דבחינת אדם קדמון נקרא אדם דבריאה דרך כללות,
phrases.en: for it is known that *Adam Kadmon* is called, in general, the Man of *Beriya*,

phrases.he: והוא בחינת המחשבה
phrases.en: and it is thought;

phrases.he: ועתיק יומין ואריך אנפין דאצילות נקרא אדם דיצירה,
phrases.en: *Atik Yomin* and *Arich Anpin* of *Atzilus* are called the Man of *Yetzira*,

phrases.he: וזעיר אנפין ונוקבא אדם דעשיה כו'
phrases.en: and *Zeir Anpin* and *Nukva* the Man of *Asiya*.

phrases.he: וכמו שהבריאה היא התהוות יש מאין ממש כידוע,
phrases.en: And just as *Beriya* is a coming into being *yesh me'ayin* (something from nothing) *mamash*, as is known,

phrases.he: כך גם בחינת כתר דאדם קדמון זה נקרא בריאה יש מאין האמיתי
phrases.en: so this *Keser* of *Adam Kadmon* is called the true creation *yesh me'ayin*

phrases.he: דאור אין סוף עצמו שבקו הנזכר לעיל הנקרא רצון קדום לעצמו כו'.
phrases.en: of the *Or Ein Sof* itself in the *Kav* mentioned above, which is called the *ratzon kadum* for Himself.

phrases.he: וביאור הדברים ידוע,
phrases.en: The explanation of this is known:

phrases.he: להיות מבואר למעלה דרצון קדום הנזכר לעיל הוא הנקרא מקור כל הרצונות
phrases.en: it was explained above that the *ratzon kadum* is the one called the source of all wills,

phrases.he: שהוא בחינת רצון ההיולי
phrases.en: for it is the *hiyuli* (raw potential) will,

phrases.he: להיות ממנו נמצא מקור לכל רצון לרצון
phrases.en: so that from it there is a source for every *ratzon l'ratzon* (will for a will).

sections.title: An example from the soul: the will for a will is a new creation
sections.summary: When the essential desire for kindness in the *yechida* turns to one thing, it is first a hidden will still for itself; when it dresses itself in the intellect and thought of that thing, it is a new creation, called *Beriya*. No class reads these lines; after a jump in the tape, his explanation of the last two is heard.

phrases.he: ויובן זה על דרך דוגמא מבחינת יחידה שבנפש האדם,
phrases.en: This can be understood by an example from the *yechida* (the essence) of the human soul:

phrases.he: כשעצמיות חפץ חסד שבה,
phrases.en: when the essential *chafetz chesed* (desire for kindness) in it,

phrases.he: שבהתכללות בבחינת היולי כולל כל מה שעתיד לחפוץ ברצון של חסד פרטי כו'
phrases.en: which, included as a *hiyuli*, includes everything it will ever desire in a particular will of kindness,

phrases.he: כאשר בא ונמשך בדרך פרט לדבר א'
phrases.en: comes and is drawn in a particular way to one thing,

phrases.he: ויוצא מבחינת העצמיות להיות לו רצון עצמי הנעלם
phrases.en: and goes out of the essence, so that there is a hidden essential will,

phrases.he: שהוא בחינת רצון קדום הנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: which is the *ratzon kadum* mentioned above,

phrases.he: אבל עדיין בלתי מלובש באותו הדבר כלל,
phrases.en: but still not dressed in that thing at all;

phrases.he: רק שהרצון הוא לעצמו עדיין כנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: the will is still for itself, as mentioned above.

phrases.he: אך כאשר מלובש ופועל רצון לרצון בדבר הפרטי הזה,
phrases.en: But when a will for a will is dressed in this particular thing and acts in it,

phrases.he: כמו שמתלבש ופועל רצון לרצון בשכל ומחשבה בדבר פרט הזה,
phrases.en: as a will for a will dresses itself and acts in the intellect and thought on this particular thing,

phrases.he: הרי התהוות זה הרצון שבשכל ומחשבה לדבר זה הוא כמו התהוות בריאה חדשה ממקורו
phrases.en: the coming into being of this will in the intellect and thought for this thing is like the coming into being of a new creation from its source;

phrases.he: והוא מפני שבחינת רצון קדום הנזכר לעיל הוא המקור להתהוות הרצון לרצון הזה שבשכל כו',
phrases.en: and that is because the *ratzon kadum* mentioned above is the source from which this will for a will in the intellect comes into being.

phrases.he: ונקרא רצון לרצון זה בריאה
phrases.en: And this will for a will is called *Beriya* (creation).

phrases.he: שהרי אנו רואים שלא בכל העתים יהיה לאדם רצון לרצון פרטי,
phrases.en: For we see that a person does not have a particular will for a will at all times,

phrases.he: כמו הרצון במסחור או בלימוד
phrases.en: like the will for trade (*mischar*) or for study;

phrases.he: שבהכרח יש מקור המהווה לרצון זה הפרטי ונקרא רצון לרצון זה,
phrases.en: so there must be a source that brings this particular will into being, and it is called this will for a will.

blocks.text: Sometimes he wants *mischar* (trade) and sometimes he doesn't want *mischar*: that is the will for himself, which is causing the will for a will. He wants to be himself and he wants to have all the things he needs, so it will make a will to have a will for anything he needs to be himself.
blocks.outOfPlace: After "And that was chapter 17" the recording jumps from 6:20 to 6:30 and resumes in the middle of these lines; the jump probably cut the reading of lines 1-14.

blocks.text: That is why the *ratzon kadum* is not a *beriya chadasha* (a new creation). It was always there, and it is called *ayin*: it is part of the true *ayin*. In other words, it is not an actual existence. *Ayin* doesn't mean it is a nothing, because if it is a nothing, how did it make the something? It means that it is not a something by itself. The *ratzon kadum* is literally part of Himself; it is not really a separate entity, it is not a something.
blocks.outOfPlace: After "And that was chapter 17" the recording jumps from 6:20 to 6:30 and resumes in the middle of these lines; the jump probably cut the reading of lines 1-14.

sections.title: Not always there: the source of the will for a will also comes from nothing, like a bribe
sections.summary: The will for a will comes and goes and shines strongly or weakly, so its source too comes into being something from nothing. A bribe shows it: it reaches the essence of the soul, and from it a will to acquit is always drawn.

phrases.he: וממילא מובן מאחר שלא בכל העתים נמשך הרצון לרצון זה,
phrases.en: So it is understood: since this will for a will is not drawn at all times,

phrases.he: וגם לפעמים יאיר אור רב ותקיף
phrases.en: and sometimes a great, strong light shines

phrases.he: ולפעמים יאיר במיעוט וחלישות כו',
phrases.en: and sometimes it shines little and weakly,

phrases.he: נמצא מוכרח שגם המקור העושה ומהוה לרצון זה,
phrases.en: it follows of necessity that the source that makes this will and brings it into being,

phrases.he: הנקרא רצון לרצון,
phrases.en: called the will for a will,

phrases.he: הוא גם כן בא בבחינת התהוות יש מאין
phrases.en: also comes as a coming into being *yesh me'ayin*.

phrases.he: כמו השוחד,
phrases.en: Like a bribe (*shochad*),

phrases.he: שיעשה רצון לרצון ושכל לזכות תמיד
phrases.en: which makes a will for a will and an intellect to acquit, always,

phrases.he: מפני שהשוחד מגיע בעצמות נפשו,
phrases.en: because the bribe reaches the essence of his soul,

phrases.he: שמחמתו יומשך תמיד התהוות רצון לרצון של חסד וזכות
phrases.en: so that because of it there is always drawn the coming into being of a will for a will of kindness and acquittal;

phrases.he: ולהיפך לשונאו יתהווה תמיד רצון לרצון של דין כו'
phrases.en: and the opposite: toward his enemy there always comes into being a will for a will of *din* (judgement),

phrases.he: וכהאי גוונא ודי למבין.
phrases.en: and the like. This is enough for one who understands.

blocks.text: Read from the second half of line 15, "it follows of necessity", through line 18, with one remark on the example: "Like a bribe." The bribe reaches the essence of the soul, so a will to acquit keeps coming; toward an enemy, a will to condemn.

sections.title: Ten wills for a will: the ten sefiros of Adam Kadmon, hidden source of Atzilus
sections.summary: Every revealed will has ten, so there are ten wills for a will: the ten *sefiros* of *Adam Kadmon*, wills for whatever the *dira b'tachtonim* needs, dirt included. They are the hidden root of the revealed *sefiros* of *Atzilus*.

phrases.he: וידוע דכל רצון גלוי כלול מי'.
phrases.en: It is known that any revealed will is made up of ten.

phrases.he: אם כן גם הרצון לרצון זה כלול מי'
phrases.en: So we must say that this will for a will is also made up of ten.

phrases.he: ויש י' כחות,
phrases.en: There are ten powers;

phrases.he: ממילא יש י' מיני רצון לרצון,
phrases.en: so there are ten kinds of will for a will,

phrases.he: שמתהווים כולם בבחינת יש מאין כו'
phrases.en: and all of them come in a way of *yesh me'ayin*.

blocks.text: **any revealed will is made up of ten**. If so, **we must say that this will for a will is also made up of ten**: there are ten powers, so there are ten kinds of will for a will, and **all of them come in a way of *yesh me'ayin***.

phrases.he: וכל זה דוגמא להבין בבחינת עשר ספירות דאדם קדמון,
phrases.en: This is all an example, to understand the ten *sefiros* of *Adam Kadmon*,

phrases.he: שכללותם ענין רצון לרצון לבד
phrases.en: which, as a whole, are only a matter of will for a will.

blocks.text: **This is all an example** for the ten *sefiros* of *Adam Kadmon*. That's the whole thing with *Adam Kadmon*: a will for a will that came out of the *ratzon kadum*. When He had this *ratzon kadum*, to have a *dira b'tachtonim* (a dwelling below), there came a will for a will for anything that is necessary in order to have it. So there was the will for *Atzilus*: to think to Himself what it is that He wants in the *dira b'tachtonim*.

Then there was a will for *Beriya*, to come up with an actual concept, like an architect. Then a will for *Yetzira*, to come up with the actual form of the thing, all the way to *Asiya*, to actually bring it into an actual building, the actual world. And that included a will for things that are even opposite to the will, which are needed in order to get to it: like a bunch of dirt.

blocks.title: The wife at the building site
blocks.text: When a man is building a house, he takes his wife there, and she's very happy. And the other lady says to her: "What are you happy about? I thought you hate dirt. Look at this, there's a bunch of dirty guys here, dirty lowlifes, trash-type of people, building this house, in your house, with cigarettes in their mouth. You hate cigarettes. And here's these guys cursing and banging with hammers and making noise, and there's dirt all over the place, and dust, and lowlifes, exactly the kind of people you don't want around, and you're happy. Why? It's *mamash* the opposite of what you would want in your house. This is what your husband is giving you, and instead of shouting at him you're so happy he brought you here. Wow, look at that." She said: "Yeah, because that's how I'm going to get the final thing." And that's the thing here too: the *Aibershter* made all kinds of things, *mamash* lowlifes.

sensitivity.reason: Builders on a site are called dirty guys, lowlifes and trash-type people.
sensitivity.publishable: When a man is building a house, he takes his wife there, and she's very happy. And the other lady says to her: "What are you happy about? I thought you hate dirt. Look at this, rough workmen building your house with cigarettes in their mouth. You hate cigarettes. And they're cursing and banging with hammers and making noise, and there's dirt all over the place, and dust, exactly what you don't want around, and you're happy. Why? It's *mamash* the opposite of what you would want in your house. This is what your husband is giving you, and instead of shouting at him you're so happy he brought you here." She said: "Yeah, because that's how I'm going to get the final thing." And that's the thing here too: the *Aibershter* made all kinds of things, even ones that look like the opposite.

blocks.text: The whole world is full of lowlifes.

sensitivity.reason: A blunt remark that the world is full of lowlifes.
sensitivity.publishable: The whole world is full of such things.

blocks.text: And He said, and He saw, it is very good. What's so good about it? He said: "Yeah, because this is what's going to get Me the final thing", including even the *yetzer hara* (the evil inclination), because the *yetzer hara* seems like the opposite of the thing.

That is the will for a will: it brings out the will for a will in order to get the final thing, anything that you need in order to get the final thing. And there are ten powers, so there are ten wills for a will, and all come into existence *yesh me'ayin*. So the ten *sefiros* of *Adam Kadmon*, as a whole, are only will for a will.

phrases.he: שהרי הן בחינת ההעלם דעשר ספירות דאצילות שבגלוי כידוע
phrases.en: For they are the concealment (*helem*) of the ten *sefiros* of *Atzilus*, which are revealed, as is known.

blocks.text: That is the *helem*; and *Atzilus*, as will be learned later, is nothing but the *gilui* (revelation) of *Adam Kadmon*. In other words, *Adam Kadmon* is a new creation, something from nothing. *Atzilus* is not. *Atzilus* is just a revelation of something that was already there in *Adam Kadmon*.

phrases.he: וכמו כתר דחכמה דאצילות שהוא הרצון שבשכל כו'
phrases.en: Like *Keser* of *chachma* of *Atzilus*, which is the will in the intellect:

phrases.he: שרשו בכתר שבחכמה דאדם קדמון
phrases.en: its root is in *Keser* of *chachma* of *Adam Kadmon*,

phrases.he: שנקרא רצון לרצון זה
phrases.en: which is called this will for a will.

phrases.he: וכן כתר שבחסד דאצילות מכתר שבחסד דאדם קדמון כו'
phrases.en: And so *Keser* of *chesed* of *Atzilus* comes from *Keser* of *chesed* of *Adam Kadmon*.

blocks.text: *Keser* of *chachma* of *Atzilus* is **the will in the intellect**, the will of *chachma*, and **its root is in *Keser* of *chachma* of *Adam Kadmon***: that's where it's rooted. In other words, the will for *chachma* comes from the will for a will for *chachma*. And so in general: ***Keser* of *chesed* of *Atzilus* comes from *Keser* of *chesed* of *Adam Kadmon***, and so on.

sections.title: From the Kav: the last level of the ratzon kadum becomes Keser of Adam Kadmon
sections.summary: The ten *sefiros* of *Adam Kadmon* come from the *Kav*, here the *ratzon kadum* itself. Its *Malchus*, the ambition to have the thing in deed, becomes *Keser* of *Adam Kadmon*: the will to have any will needed. *Adam Kadmon* is the *ma'atzil*, and *Atzilus* only reveals it.

phrases.he: ואמנם התהוות עשר ספירות דאדם קדמון עצמו,
phrases.en: But the coming into being of the ten *sefiros* of *Adam Kadmon* itself

phrases.he: הכל נמשך מבחינת הקו
phrases.en: all comes from the *Kav*,

phrases.he: שנקרא מקור התהוות כל הרצונות לרצונות כו'
phrases.en: which is called the source of the coming into being of all wills for wills,

phrases.he: להיותו עצם הרצון הפשוט
phrases.en: since it is the very essence of the *ratzon hapashut* (the simple will)

phrases.he: שקדם בעצמו שיהיה כך כנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: that preceded in Himself, that it should be so, as explained before.

blocks.text: **the coming into being of the ten *sefiros* of *Adam Kadmon* itself … all comes from the *Kav***: by the *Kav* here he means the *ratzon kadum*, the *machshava kduma* (the primordial thought). The *ratzon kadum* is really the actual *etzem* of the will, of the *ratzon hapashut*. It is just the will coming out of the simple will, which from the first was that it should be like this, as explained before.

phrases.he: על כן הוא פועל ועושה רצון לרצון בדרך פרט
phrases.en: Therefore it acts and makes a will for a will *derech prat* (in a particular way),

phrases.he: והוא מבחינת כתר דאדם קדמון עד בחינת מלכות שבו,
phrases.en: from *Keser* of *Adam Kadmon* down to its *Malchus*,

phrases.he: שהוא בחינת רצון לרצון דמלוכה כו'
phrases.en: which is the will for a will of kingship.

blocks.text: So it makes a will for a will *derech prat*, from *Keser* of *Adam Kadmon* down to *Malchus* of *Adam Kadmon*, which is **the will for a will of kingship**, to actually make the house: the *Asiya*.

phrases.he: ואמנם רק מבחינת אחרונה שברצון הקדום ההיולי הנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: But only from the last level of the *hiyuli ratzon kadum* mentioned above

phrases.he: נעשה בחינת כתר דאדם קדמון
phrases.en: does *Keser* of *Adam Kadmon* come about:

phrases.he: שהוא רצון לרצון הנעלם
phrases.en: which is the hidden will for a will,

phrases.he: שלמעלה מחכמה שברצון לרצון הנעלם כו'
phrases.en: which is higher than the *chachma* of the hidden will for a will.

blocks.text: That was in general. In particular, it is only from *Malchus* of the *ratzon kadum* that *Keser* of *Adam Kadmon* comes. **the hidden will for a will** means the will for the will for a will. It is **higher than the *chachma*** of *Adam Kadmon*: it is *Keser* of *Adam Kadmon*. And *Keser* of *Adam Kadmon* means the will that comes from the last thing in the *ratzon kadum*, its *Malchus*. As he said before, the last circle is the circle for an actual deed.

In other words, in the ambitious daydream there is finally the thing: to actually do it. From that comes the will to come up with any will which is necessary in order to do it. From *Malchus* of the *ratzon kadum*, the inner ambition to actually have this thing in deed, comes the *Keser*: the will to come up with any will he might need. That is the *Keser* of the will for a will, which is still higher than *chachma* of *Adam Kadmon*.

phrases.he: ועל דרך זה כל עשר ספירות דאדם קדמון, הכל בבחינת ההעלם
phrases.en: And in the same way all ten *sefiros* of *Adam Kadmon* are all in concealment,

phrases.he: ורצון לרצון לכל עשר ספירות דאצילות שבא בבחינת גלוי,
phrases.en: and a will for a will for all ten *sefiros* of *Atzilus*, which come in revelation,

phrases.he: כמו שיתבאר ודי למבין:
phrases.en: as will be explained. This is enough for one who understands.

blocks.text: **And in the same way all ten *sefiros* of *Adam Kadmon* are all in concealment**, a will for a will for the ten *sefiros* of *Atzilus*, which come in revelation. **as will be explained**: how *Atzilus* is nothing but a revelation of *Adam Kadmon*. In other words, *Atzilus* is not a new thing.

*Adam Kadmon* is a new thing. Not only that: a lot of people don't understand what it means when it says the *ma'atzil* (the one who emanates). They think the *ma'atzil* is His very Essence and Being. That's not true. The *ma'atzil* is *Adam Kadmon*, and *Atzilus* is *ne'etzal* (emanated) not from the *Atzmus* but from *Adam Kadmon*. In various places, someone will say, "Well, I read that *Atzilus* comes from the *Atzmus*." No: that means *Adam Kadmon*, because, as will be seen later on, *Adam Kadmon* is still considered part of the *etzem*.

sections.title: Like the pizza: a will for a will vanishes as if it never was
sections.summary: *Adam Kadmon* is the Man of *Beriya* because a will for a will is created from nothing, and stays nothing: when the reason for it goes, it is gone without a trace, as the world would be if the *Aibershter* took His mind off it.

phrases.he: וזהו שבחינת אדם קדמון נקרא אדם דבריאה כו',
phrases.en: This is why *Adam Kadmon* is called the Man of *Beriya*:

phrases.he: כמו בחינת התהוות יש מאין
phrases.en: like a coming into being *yesh me'ayin*,

phrases.he: כנראה בחוש
phrases.en: as is seen plainly,

phrases.he: שהתהוות הרצון לרצון לעתים מיוחדים הוא בא,
phrases.en: that the will for a will comes into being at particular times,

phrases.he: כשאר התהוות איזה מציאות כו'
phrases.en: like the coming into being of any other existence.

blocks.text: **This is why *Adam Kadmon* is called the Man of *Beriya***: it is *mamash* something from nothing. **as is seen plainly** that the will for a will comes into being.

blocks.title: The buddy who brought a pizza
blocks.text: As we said: the guy wants a pizza, so right away this creates a will to have a will to find his keys, and find his wallet, and get in his car, etc., etc., etc. And all of a sudden there's a knock on his door, and his buddy says: "Hey, I came over and I brought a pizza. Let's have some pizza and watch the football game." So all of a sudden, what happened to all the will for a will to get his keys and get in the car? Will he tell the guy, "Sorry, I can't eat pizza and watch the football game with you, because I'm going out in my car; I have a will to go out in my car"? Not true. It won't happen like that. The will to go out in his car, since it is a new creation *yesh me'ayin*, will disappear as if it never existed.

blocks.question: Why would the world cease to exist if the *Aibershter* took His mind off it for a second?
blocks.text: This is also how it is with the world. People said: what do you mean, the world would literally cease to exist if the *Aibershter* removed His mind from it for one second? It's not that it would be destroyed. You wouldn't have to destroy it. It would just *lechatchila* (from the outset) cease to exist, as if it never existed in the first place. And you see what happens here to all the wills for a will: they disappear.

blocks.title: The pizza: no avoda needed to drop it
blocks.text: And it's not that he says, "Okay, well, now let me work on myself. I have to do some *avoda* to get rid of the will to get in my car and go to the pizza store." It doesn't happen like that. It just disappears, as if it totally never was; it doesn't even leave a *reshimu* (an impression). You ask him, "So what happened? I thought you were going to get in the car and go for the pizza." "Hey, my buddy is here with a pizza. Everything else was incidental." Yeah, it's gone. It never existed.

Even after it was created, it is still *yesh me'ayin*, still a nothing. It really doesn't exist. It has absolutely none of its own existence, and if the thing that brings it into existence goes away, either because he stops wanting it for another reason or because he already got it, it's gone. You don't need it. And that really applies to the whole of *Atzilus*, *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya*: the angels, everything. It's all incidental.

sections.title: Where a will for a will first appears: thought, the hidden thought of Adam Kadmon
sections.summary: Thought is the vessel of the will, so a will for a will first comes into being in thought, the will in thought. That is *Keser*, *chachma* and *bina* of *Adam Kadmon*: the action of the will for a will in the *machshava stima'a* of *Adam Kadmon*.

phrases.he: והוא כמו התהוות המחשבה,
phrases.en: It is like the coming into being of thought,

phrases.he: שהיא התהוות יש מאין לגבי עצמיות הרצון שבנפשו
phrases.en: which is a coming into being *yesh me'ayin* relative to the essence of the will in one's soul.

phrases.he: כנראה בחוש שהרצון לרצון הבא בבחינת התהוות כנזכר לעיל,
phrases.en: As is seen plainly, the will for a will that comes as a coming into being, as said above,

phrases.he: תחלת התהוותו במחשבה דוקא
phrases.en: first comes into being in thought, *davka*.

blocks.text: **It is like the coming into being of thought**: like when a thought comes up from a *midda* (an attribute). It is a coming into being *yesh me'ayin* relative to the essence of the will. And it is seen plainly that the will for a will **first comes into being in thought**: in general, any will comes into being in a thought.

phrases.he: כי המחשבה בחינת כלי לרצון,
phrases.en: For thought is a *kli* (vessel) for the will:

phrases.he: שהרצון מתלבש במחשבה,
phrases.en: the will dresses itself in thought,

phrases.he: כמו וחשב לעשות כו'
phrases.en: as in "and he thought to do."

phrases.he: וכן תחלת התהוות רצון לרצון במחשבה,
phrases.en: And so the first coming into being of the will for a will is in thought,

phrases.he: הוא שנקרא רצון שבמחשבה כו'
phrases.en: and that is what is called the will in thought.

blocks.text: **For thought is a *kli* (vessel) for the will**: in any place, in order to have a will, you have to think of it. I want such and such a thing: you have to think, "I want that pizza." **the will dresses itself in thought**, as it says of Haman that he thought to do, which means he wanted to do.

So the first coming into being of a will for a will is in thought, and it is called **the will in thought**: this will of a thought. Later on he will explain that there are two kinds of thought: there is a thought of a will, and there is a thought of an *iyun* (analysis), the thought of the intellect.

phrases.he: וזהו כללות ענין כח''ב דאדם קדמון
phrases.en: And this is the whole matter of *Keser*, *chachma* and *bina* of *Adam Kadmon*:

phrases.he: שהוא בחינת התהוות פעולת אור רצון לרצון דרך פרט
phrases.en: the coming into being of the action of the light of the will for a will *derech prat*,

phrases.he: שבא במחשבה סתימאה כו'
phrases.en: which comes in the *machshava stima'a* (the hidden thought).

blocks.text: **the whole matter of *Keser*, *chachma* and *bina* of *Adam Kadmon***, which means the thought of *Adam Kadmon*, is **the coming into being of the action of the light of the will for a will *derech prat*, which comes in the *machshava stima'a***. That means the *machshava stima'a* of *Adam Kadmon*, not the *machshava stima'a* of *Arich*. This is the total hiddenness of *Adam Kadmon*.

sections.title: Above it, the Kav itself: thinking only of himself, like the Rambam's self-knowledge
sections.summary: The *ratzon kadum* is above even the hidden thought of *Adam Kadmon*: it still thinks only to itself all that will be, sitting and not yet a chair. That is what the *Rambam* calls "His knowledge of Himself", which is the *machshava kduma* and not the *Atzmus*.

phrases.he: מה שאין כן בבחינת הקו עצמו
phrases.en: Not so the *Kav* itself,

phrases.he: שלמעלה מבחינת פעולת התהוות רצון לרצון לדבר פרט במחשבה סתימאה גם כן כו'
phrases.en: which is higher even than the action of bringing a will for a will for a particular thing into being in the hidden thought:

phrases.he: רק לעצמו עדיין חושב כל מה שיהיה כו'
phrases.en: it still thinks, only to itself, all that will be,

phrases.he: שכולל במחשבת עצמו עדיין
phrases.en: including it still in its thought of itself,

phrases.he: ולא בהתהוות רצון במחשבה שחוץ ממנו כלל ודי למבין
phrases.en: and not in the coming into being of a will in a thought that is outside of it at all. This is enough for one who understands.

blocks.text: **Not so the *Kav* itself**: over there it is called *stima d'chol stimin* (the most hidden of all hidden), not just *stima'a*. And here he is actually talking about the *ratzon kadum*, not the actual *Kav*: **it still thinks, only to itself, all that will be**. It includes really what he is thinking about himself. Not about the pizza yet.

blocks.title: Sell the sizzle, not the steak
blocks.text: You know how they tell you, when you're selling, you sell the sizzle and not the steak? That's what they mean. If you want to become a good salesman, you've got to know how to reach the *ratzon kadum*: the will for himself.

He is still really thinking to himself, **including it still in its thought of itself**. In other words, he is thinking of sitting, not of a chair. And of course sitting includes in it that there will be a will for a will to go and buy a chair. It is not yet a will in a thought which is outside of him.

phrases.he: (ובלשון הרמב''ם היינו בידיעת עצמו
phrases.en: (In the language of the *Rambam*, this is "in His knowledge of Himself,"

phrases.he: ולא בידיעה שחוץ ממנו וכו'
phrases.en: and not in a knowledge outside of Him,

phrases.he: וכמו שכתוב במקום אחר):
phrases.en: as is written elsewhere.)

blocks.text: **In the language of the *Rambam***: a lot of people think that what the *Rambam* is talking about is the *Atzmus*. It's not the *Atzmus*. It is the *hiyuli* of thought. **"in His knowledge of Himself"** is the *machshava kduma*, as is explained elsewhere. And that's the end of the chapter.

reviewQuestions.question: Why is *Adam Kadmon* a new creation, something from nothing, while *Atzilus* is not?
What does the wife at the building site show about the wills for a will that make up *Adam Kadmon*?
From which level of the *ratzon kadum* does *Keser* of *Adam Kadmon* come, and what is it a will for?
Who is the *ma'atzil*, and what does it mean when someone reads that *Atzilus* comes from the *Atzmus*?
What happens to the will to drive to the pizza store when the buddy shows up, and what does that say about the world?
How is the *Kav* itself different from the hidden thought of *Adam Kadmon*, and what is the *Rambam*'s "knowledge of Himself"?

Lines 15-20 and 41-43 are read with no translation of their own; their phrases follow his wording where he gives any ("so we must say", "they all of them come in a way of yesh me'ayin") and are otherwise a plain rendering.
